response.sql: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) as ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as overall_avg_ratio FROM patient_ratios), first_filter AS (SELECT pr.ID, pr.ratio, pr.ratio - oa.overall_avg_ratio as above_overall FROM patient_ratios pr CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE pr.ratio > oa.overall_avg_ratio), second_avg AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as second_avg_ratio FROM first_filter), second_filter AS (SELECT ff.ID, ff.ratio, ff.above_overall, ff.ratio - sa.second_avg_ratio as above_second_avg FROM first_filter ff CROSS JOIN second_avg sa WHERE ff.ratio > sa.second_avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio, AVG(above_overall) as avg_above_overall, AVG(above_second_avg) as avg_above_second_avg FROM second_filter
